note: Source skildi is mistagged VBDI/skilja but is the dative object of valda, coordinated with shooting a bow. Kaikki s.v. skjǫldr gives shield and its i-umlaut oblique stem. Correct locally to skjöldur/N-D.

Source s2083 Sám is tagged VBDI/sá, followed by first-person plural subject vér and object það. Kaikki s.v. sjá verb derives see from *sehwaną; local correction avoids sowing/demonstrative homographs.

Source minnum is NS-D in the expression preserving events in memory. Kaikki s.v. minni noun memory < *(ga)minþiją differs from comparative minni. Isolate this occurrence; another noun sense mouth prevents a blanket noun-memory equation.
Source félli is VBPS with property passing away from heirs. Kaikki s.v. falla supports fall, not fell skin/mountain; correct the local erroneous lemma féll.
Source beðið takes the person Loft and an infinitival request. Kaikki s.v. biðja ask < *bidjaną, distinct from bíða wait. Local correction to biðja retains participial tag.
Source vita is N-A object of brenni. Kaikki s.v. viti includes beacon; source describes burning one at sea. Isolate viti@beacon; do not transfer vita know or pronoun mappings.
Source sé has object eyrun and first-person subject eg. Kaikki s.v. sjá see distinguishes perception from vera; repair local lemma and BEPS to VBPS.

Source heitt describes preparation of ale, coordinated with slaughter and mead mixing. Cleasby–Vigfusson s.v. heita I (https://cleasby-vigfusson-dictionary.vercel.app/word/heita) gives heating and ale brewing, distinct from calling. Isolate heita@heat.
Source mjöður is the subject of blandinn and wrongly lemmatized mjöða/NS-N. Kaikki s.v. mjǫðr and the existing mjöður table give mead < *médʰu. Correct to mjöður/N-N.
Source öxn is NS-N with felld at feast preparation. Kaikki s.v. uxi gives ox < *uksḗn. Correct the unnormalized plural lemma locally to uxi.
